protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: Horizon placed a Keystone project name into a downloaded OpenRC shell assignment. The pre-fix template used export OS_PROJECT_NAME="{{ tenant_name|shellfilter }}", while shellfilter escaped backslash, backtick, single quote, and double quote but not dollar-sign or exclamation-mark. A project name containing $(command) therefore remains active inside double quotes and runs when a victim sources the file; Launchpad 2152240 supplies a concrete harmless touch-file PoC. Exploitation requires project-create or rename privilege and victim download/source interaction.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: a68d35e52f449c54c27c3e680a562d326a83479b is the smallest public first-write for this project-name mechanism. Its two-file atomic change derives tenant_name from the selected tenant choice and changes the template from tenant_id-only naming to export OS_TENANT_NAME={{ tenant_name }}. Earlier OpenRC commits 6388d3e7659454f31e8343c5fbacd69f882bf606 and e69ec810dd86e529518dbb7b574b367b9280e9f8 interpolate IDs and username, not a project or tenant name. Later quoting, incomplete filtering, and OS_PROJECT_NAME aliasing preserve or duplicate the already-introduced mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: the sole parent is 1e8ba66fe4cac98ad840e60973e643d6eb35010c. Its OpenRC template exports OS_TENANT_NAME from tenant_id, and an exact parent-tree grep finds no {{ tenant_name occurrence in shell or template files.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLICABLE: a68d35e52f449c54c27c3e680a562d326a83479b has exactly one parent, is not a merge, and is a focused Gerrit change whose form-to-template data flow is introduced together. No squash aggregate or finer publicly reconstructable member was found, so decomposed_shas=[] is correct.

protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: single-parent commit c7863093c67a554b527ddfb8b48fff7d37d140b5 directly adds dollar-sign and exclamation-mark escaping to shellfilter and consistently quotes or filters remaining generated OpenRC values. Its parent 1477abd588b9477d002344fcfca5b69b2fc4a88f still leaves dollar-sign unescaped and retains the vulnerable OS_PROJECT_NAME interpolation. Launchpad marks horizon Fix Released, ossa Won't Fix, and ossn Fix Released; canonical OSSN-0097 recommends upgrading to a version containing the fix.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: attribution was evaluated only on BIC a68d35e52f449c54c27c3e680a562d326a83479b. Its 2012 commit object names Gabriel Hurley as author and committer and contains only the bug reference and Gerrit Change-Id, with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker. Signals on the 2026 fix are irrelevant. NOT_AI is therefore supported.
